visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Night scene on a decorated rooftop. A group of five young people are gathered around a barbecue grill and table, sitting in camping chairs. A bald man in a colorful floral shirt approaches them, looking frustrated and gesturing towards them while speaking. Fairy lights and purple ambient lighting illuminate the area. (2) After a graphic text transition "半小時後", the scene shifts to the same location. The man in the floral shirt is now actively helping the group clean up the barbecue area, picking up items and interacting with the others in a friendly manner. The young people are standing around him, talking and smiling. (3) Following another text transition "一小時後", the man in the floral shirt is now the center of the party. He is dancing enthusiastically, holding a beverage, and laughing loudly. He puts his arms around two of the young men as they celebrate together. The atmosphere is high-energy and celebratory with vibrant colors.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with ambient outdoor chatter and sizzling sounds. A man's voice enters with a sharp, inquisitive tone, questioning the group at a high volume and energy. Light, upbeat rhythmic music plays in the background at a moderate level. (2) A digital "ding" sound effect triggers a new phase. The man's vocal tone shifts to a helpful, higher-pitched delivery as he coordinates cleaning. Multiple young voices respond with bright, excited interjections and overlapping laughter. (3) A "whoosh" transition sound leads into a louder, bass-heavy EDM track. The man's voice becomes highly aroused, shouting joyfully and laughing hysterically. He sings along with the music, accompanied by rhythmic clapping and collective cheering from the group.
